verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README describe `task start`/`yy init` hydrating a dedicated worktree from a protected base SHA and completing 'configured dependency hydration' before reporting WORKING, which covers automated environment setup and dependency install; the CLI is confirmed live on npm and the repo public. Missing for 10: explicit description of cloning an arbitrary remote repo (vs. hydrating a pre-defined workspace), and independent/hands-on confirmation that dependency install works end-to-end.
